content.value: A wheel of radius r and centrodial radius of gyration k is placed on an incline and released 17 from rest at time t = 0. Assuming that the wheels rolls without slipping, determine, (i) The velocity of the center at time t (ii) The co-efficient of static friction required to prevent slipping.
